title: UserProvisioningChangeResponseDataType
description: Response DataType for a UserProvisioning change request. Captures outcome code, human-readable description and optional error message.
x-ecohub-license: © 2025 EcoHub AG. Usage restricted. Prior written authorization required. Swiss law applies. Jurisdiction: Zurich.

code.description: Outcome code: OK, PENDING, USER_EXISTS, or ERROR.

description.description:
Human readable explanation of the code. Examples:
- OK: The user was created at the service provider (synchronous).
- PENDING: Request received; user not yet created (asynchronous).
- USER_EXISTS: A user with the same IDP_UserID already exists.
- ERROR: An internal error occurred; see errorMessage for stack trace.

errorMessage.description: Optional error details or stack trace when code is ERROR.
